main: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape 16:9 indie game key art and MAIN MENU BACKGROUND, no text or UI. References: image1 original Starfire Wayfarer hero design, image2 Abyss Lord enemy design, image3 golden mossy ruins environment. Keep the hero's short dark teal hood, split ivory mask with amber eye slits, asymmetrical cloak, brown leather and rune lantern; do not make Minecraft heads. Hero stands in LEFT third foreground, right hand sword pointing downward, left hand magical blue ember. On RIGHT distant third the jagged obsidian Abyss Lord looms above ruined arch, subtle purple/orange core. Golden sandstone ruins, navy banners, ivy, blue portal, dramatic distant bell tower, small glowing embers, sweeping depth. Center middle third has quiet misty architectural negative space for later title and buttons, no high contrast objects in center. Premium stylized pixel-painted low-poly fantasy, crisp pixel clusters, cinematic warm gold sun versus cool teal shadows, beautiful detailed lighting, painterly staging, not photoreal, not a screenshot, original recognizable game world. Full bleed, no border, no letters or watermark.
loading: Create a 16:9 landscape illustration for a fantasy game's LOADING PANEL BACKGROUND and promotional image. Same original Starfire Wayfarer universe as reference: pixel-painted low-poly dark fantasy with teal, antique gold, warm ivory sandstone. An adventurer's navigation table viewed slightly from above inside ruined arch: at extreme left a small amber rune lantern, ivory split mask and folded dark teal hood; at far right a sheathed sword, rolled parchment, small blue portal compass, a handful of red and gold loot gems. Center 65 percent is a beautifully textured DARK NAVY CLOTH MAP laid flat, faint embossed branching dungeon pathways and constellation marks at very low contrast, QUIET CLEAR SPACE suitable for white loading progress and tips overlaid by code. Background corners reveal mossy stone, warm torchlight and floating ember particles. Carefully light materials at the perimeter, do not fill the center with busy objects. Elegant stylized pixel clusters, faceted hand-crafted forms, painterly cinematic shading, limited palette consistent with reference. Full bleed opaque image, no text, numbers, UI, bar, logo, border or watermark.
pause: Create a beautiful 16:9 landscape PAUSE MENU BACKGROUND / atmospheric game promotional illustration in the original game universe of the references. Starfire Wayfarer resting on the far LEFT under a broken sandstone arch, recognizable short teal hood, ivory split mask with thin amber eyes, sword planted beside boots, warm rune lantern on belt. Small campfire lower left, floating amber sparks. RIGHT edge an opened ancient treasure chest and low merchant supply shelf, ivy, navy-gold banner, cool blue portal far background. CENTER 50 percent is tranquil softly lit teal mist and shadowed ruined stone corridor, simple quiet negative space for an overlay settings menu, no characters in center. Evening turquoise twilight with warm lantern light, layered silhouette ruins and trees, inviting sense of safe respite, gentle cinematic depth. Match faceted low-poly pixel-painted stylization, readable pixel clusters, antique gold and ivory, rich but restrained details, not photorealistic, no copied game characters. Full bleed, no letters, logos, interface widgets or watermarks.
quest: Use case: game UI raster asset. Create ONE horizontal fantasy QUEST TRACKER BACKPLATE, aspect ratio 3:1 landscape, straight front-on, full bleed rectangular usable panel. Original sunlit ruins pixel art style, elegant narrow antique gold beveled edge and navy teal cloth map interior. Tiny compass/star rune embossed at extreme LEFT, tiny broken ivory sandstone corner ornaments and ivy only at outermost corners. Center 80 percent completely quiet dark desaturated blue cloth with very faint engraved dungeon path lines, suitable for small ivory quest text placed later by code. Crisp controlled chunky pixel clusters, 12-color palette, no photorealism, no smooth shiny gradients, consistent golden trim #d7a447 and deep teal #142b38. No text, letters, numbers, icons in center, no mockup, no surrounding scenery. Slim professional indie game interface, not baroque, not bulky. Output a single panel, no sheet.
